raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers is a type-2 history table with 230 rows for 200 customers, and the 30 superseded rows (is_current=False) are copied into silver_customers unfiltered. The inner join in gold_region_daily therefore fans out each affected transaction across two region rows, inflating the count from 4582 to 5279. Restricting the customer join to is_current rows gives one row per customer and restores the 4582 reconciliation, and the 2026 transactions fall after the current rows' valid_from of 2025-01-01, so no point-in-time change is needed.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.8,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"gold_region_daily": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold_region_daily AS SELECT t.txn_date, c.region, count(*) AS n_txn, sum(t.amount) AS total FROM silver_transactions t JOIN (SELECT customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers WHERE is_current) c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY t.txn_date, c.region;"}}
